title: Austin City Officials Observe LCRA
summary:
*   The Austin City Council attended a special meeting of the Lower Colorado River Authority (LCRA) Board of Directors.
*   Council members were present as observers and did not actively participate in the LCRA's discussions or decisions.
*   No policy decisions were made, public hearings conducted, or official minutes recorded for the Austin City Council at this gathering.
